newsitem.title: POLAND: FORECAST - Polish banks see end-97 CPI at 16.27 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Polish banks see end-97 CPI at 16.27 pct.

text.p: Inflation expectations among Polish banks increased in March after last month's drop, a monthly Reuter poll of the 26 biggest banks showed on Monday.
Banks predicted average year-on-year inflation for the end of 1997 at 16.27 percent, up from 16.17 percent predicted last month and well above the government's prediction of 13 percent.
Banks predicted monthly inflation this month against February would be 1.44 percent on average with a range of forecasts from one to two percent.
Banks predicted year-on-year inflation in March 1998 at an average 15.53 percent, with the range from 13.0 to 18.00 percent.
